answer: Bind each identity to one phone's factory sensor fingerprint. At enrollment the agent records its accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer offsets as a signed profile. Each epoch it submits readings, accepted only if the offsets match within tolerance and no second key claims the same fingerprint. A forger needs a new handset per fake identity, about $120 each, plus weeks of drift-matched readings. Like yarrow rooting in one patch of soil, each identity stays rooted in one device, so the ocean of cheap virtual accounts dries up and trust hits its nadir only when that phone is lost.
